args.title: Corvid Packaging Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost driver in retail.
- Consolidated return hubs reduce handling costs by about 20%, offering a clear efficiency lever.
- Companion piece finding: reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of their margin, underscoring the value of speed in returns processing.
